name: National Mission on Edible Oil–Oil Palm: Planting Materials
benefit: - **For Locally Sourced Planting Materials.:** ₹20,000/- per hectare - **For Imported Plants (including transportation cost):** ₹29,000/- per hectare > **Note:** For imported seedlings (along with transportation cost) the assistance will be admissible as per the holding of land held by the farmer.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a farmer. - The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat.
